question: Why did Russia call Crimea “theirs” after giving it away?
answer: In 1954 the transfer of Crimea from Russia to Ukraine was symbolic, because both were inside the same Union. When the Union dissolved, Crimea became a real loss of the peninsula that controls the Black Sea. Russia always meant to get it back and took it in 2014.
move: A border drawn as a gesture inside one state turns real when that state breaks up.
